metadata.services: Triple Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV + Voice ($110/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Ben. How may I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi, yes. My name is David Hernandez. I'm calling because I just got an email saying my account is past due and my service is about to be suspended, but I paid the bill a week ago.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Mr. Hernandez. I can certainly look into that for you. I understand how concerning an alert like that can be, especially when you've already made a payment. To pull up your account, could I please have your Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's CUST-1022.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. CUST-1022. Pulling that up now... one moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I see the account for David Hernandez. For security purposes, before we discuss any billing details, can you please verify the 4-digit security PIN associated with the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, the PIN is 2-8-7-7.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you for verifying that. You are fully authenticated. Now, let me take a look at your billing statement and recent payments.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm just worried because my internet seems to have stopped working about ten minutes ago. I assume it's related.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Yes, it does look like the system automatically placed a temporary suspension on the services due to the overdue balance flag. I apologize for that inconvenience.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: But it's not overdue. I have my bank statement right here. I paid $110.00 last Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand. Let me check the payment history. I'm showing your last payment received was for the prior month. You said you paid this recent bill through your bank's online service, is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I always use my bank's online bill pay. It's never been a problem before.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that helps clarify things. Sometimes, when a payment is initiated through a bank's system, it's sent to us as an electronic transfer, or ACH payment. Unlike a credit card payment made directly on the Cymbal website, these can take a few business days to be processed by the banks and then post to our system.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: But it's been a whole week since last Wednesday. That's five business days, isn't it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are absolutely right. It typically shouldn't take this long. It's possible there's a delay in the transfer batch from the bank or a processing hiccup. I'm not seeing the payment reflected on our side just yet.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So what does that mean for me? My internet is out, and I need it to work from home. This is a huge problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the urgency, and I assure you we will get this sorted out. Since you have confirmation of the payment on your end, we can definitely work with that. Do you have a transaction or confirmation number from your bank for that payment?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Uh, let me look. My bank's app shows a 'Trace ID'. Is that what you need?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly it. If you could provide me with that number, as well as the exact date and amount of the transaction, I can document it.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, hold on. I'm pulling it up now... Okay. The payment was for one hundred and ten dollars, exactly. It was sent on Wednesday, let's see... the 15th.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Wednesday the 15th, for $110.00. And the trace ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The number is... a bit long. It's B-K-T-R-F-R... 9-8-4-3-3-1-0-9-5.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. Let me repeat that back. B as in Bravo, K as in Kilo, T-R-F-R, followed by 984331095.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'm adding this information as a note to your account right now. This is very helpful for our billing department to trace the payment if it doesn't post automatically in the next day or two.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, but what about my service? I can't wait a day or two.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course not. We're going to fix that right now. What I am going to do is place a temporary 'Promise to Pay' hold on your account. This is a courtesy we extend in situations like this.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What does that do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It essentially tells our automated system that a payment is on the way. This will immediately lift the service suspension and prevent any further late notices or fees for the next seven days, which should be more than enough time for the bank transfer to arrive and post.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, so you can turn my internet back on right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. I will process the reactivation request at the same time. I just need to get this set up in the system. Do you mind holding for about 60 to 90 seconds while I process these two actions?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Not at all. Please, go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll be right back.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Mr. Hernandez.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'm here.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I have successfully applied the seven-day collections freeze to your account. I have also submitted the request to the system to restore your services. I have a confirmation number for that action if you'd like it for your records.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please. I'd like to have that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. The reference number is R-S-T-5-4-8-2-1.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Got it. So... how long does it take? For the internet to come back on?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The signal should be restored within the next hour, but it's often much faster, usually within 15 to 20 minutes. What I recommend is that in about 15 minutes, you unplug the power from your Cymbal Telecom modem and your TV set-top box for about 30 seconds, then plug them back in. This forces them to re-register on the network and pick up the restored signal.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, unplug and plug back in. I can do that. And this won't happen again next month, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: This type of delay is very rare. However, for future reference, the fastest way to ensure payment is posted instantly is by paying directly through your MyCymbal account portal on our website or by setting up automatic debit, which pulls on the due date.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I see. I just like to manage all my bills from my bank's dashboard. It's easier to keep track of.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand that. And in 99% of cases, it works perfectly fine. This seems to be an unfortunate exception, and I've documented it thoroughly so our billing team is aware.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What about late fees? The email mentioned a late fee would be applied.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. Let me check... yes, the system did automatically apply a standard late fee. However, given the circumstances and the note I've placed with your payment trace ID, I am going to go ahead and manually waive that fee for you right now.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh! Thank you, I appreciate that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome. It's the least we can do. I'm processing that credit now... one moment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's done. You will see a charge for the late fee and then a corresponding credit for the same amount on your next invoice, so they will cancel each other out.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's perfect. Thank you for being so helpful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Mr. Hernandez. I'm glad we could get this straightened out for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So just to be sure, I don't need to do anything else, right? I just wait for the service to come back on and the payment will eventually show up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is correct. Your part is done. The temporary hold protects your account, your services are being restored, and our billing team has the trace ID to locate the payment. You are all set.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, great. I was pretty worried there for a minute.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can imagine. It's a stressful situation. Just to recap, we've placed a 7-day hold on the account, restored your services, and waived the late fee.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. This was much easier than I expected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We try our best. While I have you, is there anything else I can assist you with today? Perhaps any questions about your account or our other services?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I don't think so. That was the only thing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Once again, my apologies for the inconvenience this issue caused.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem. You've been a big help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. We appreciate your business. Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom, and have a wonderful rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: (Sound of phone being picked up again) Hello? Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, Mr. Hernandez, I'm still here. I hadn't disconnected the call yet. Did you need something else?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, sorry! Yes, actually. I just thought of something. You mentioned setting up automatic debit. Is that hard to do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all, it's very straightforward. We can set it up right now over the phone if you'd like, or I can guide you on how to do it through your MyCymbal account online.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Maybe... maybe we can just do it now, to avoid this kind of thing in the future. What do you need?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Certainly. We can link it to a credit or debit card, or directly to a bank account using a routing and account number. Which would you prefer?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I'd prefer to use my bank account, not a card.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. For that, I would need your bank's routing number and your checking account number. For your security, I must inform you that this line is recorded, and this information will be entered directly into our secure payment portal.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's fine. I have the numbers here. I have a checkbook right in front of me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Whenever you're ready, please provide the 9-digit routing number first.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, 071000019. And now, the account number?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The account number is 8-3-3-4-5-0-2-1-1-2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me read that back. 8334502112.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the name on the bank account is just David Hernandez?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I'm entering this into the system now. Please give me one moment to save this as your primary AutoPay method.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, the information has been saved and verified by the system. I am now setting your account to be enrolled in automatic payments.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So what happens now? Will it pay the bill that's due right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a very important question. No, it will not. Enrolling in AutoPay does not trigger an immediate payment. Your payment for this current cycle is the one we're waiting on from your bank transfer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, okay. I see.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The AutoPay will begin with your *next* billing cycle. You'll still receive an email notification when your new bill is generated, and it will state that your account is scheduled for automatic payment on the due date. No action will be needed from you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds great, actually. Much less to worry about.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It certainly simplifies things. Also, as a thank you for enrolling in AutoPay and paperless billing, Cymbal Telecom offers a five dollar monthly discount. I see you're already on paperless billing, so the AutoPay enrollment now makes you eligible.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wait, really? A five dollar discount?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, sir. I'm applying that discount to your account now. It will also take effect starting with your next billing statement. So your Triple Play Bundle will be $105 plus taxes and fees, instead of $110.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wow. This call turned out to be very productive. I call in worried about a suspension and I end up with a discount. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are most welcome. It's a benefit we're happy to provide our customers. I've added the discount, it's all confirmed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So I should go ahead and do that reboot of my modem now? It's been about 15 minutes since you said.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's a great idea. If you'd like to do that while I'm on the line, I can wait and confirm with you that the internet is back online.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that would be great. I'm walking over to it now. Unplugging the power... now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Just give it about 30 seconds before you plug it back in. This allows the internal components to fully reset.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, it's been 30 seconds. Plugging it back in now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. It will now go through its startup sequence. You'll see several lights blinking. You'll want to wait until the 'Online' or globe-symbol light turns solid. This can take a minute or two.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I see the lights flashing... Power is on, send and receive are blinking...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's taking a little while... still blinking.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's normal. It's establishing a connection with our network servers.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay... wait... yes! The online light just went solid blue. Does that mean it's working?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's the one! It should be working now. Can you try to browse to a webpage on your computer or phone connected to your Cymbal Wi-Fi?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let me check on my phone... yes! It's loading. I have internet again! Thank goodness.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. I'm so glad to hear that. I'll make a final note on the account that service was successfully restored during our call.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ben, you've been incredibly helpful. Thank you so much for everything.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was truly my pleasure, Mr. Hernandez. So, just to confirm, we've addressed the payment issue, restored your service, waived the late fee, and set you up for an AutoPay discount. Is there absolutely anything else I can do for you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, that's everything. You've covered more than I even called for. I'm all set.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Well, thank you again for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer. We appreciate your patience. Have a great rest of your day.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, Ben. Thanks again. Bye.
